race.comment: UNRIDDLE (1) was racing so well before a break and finally got his victory. It did take a long time though. Has trialled like he is ready to go and from the draw, will get a sweet run. Does tend to use the barrier when he draws low. BEAU STRADA (8) was a long way off them when resuming. This time around she finds a much softer gate. Probably wants a dry track and speed on but can improve quickly. BLEAK MID WINTER (2) has shown some ability previously even if the last few don't. Did lead all the way to break the maiden. IRRESISTIBLE SIR (6) has not fared too well at the barriers but is certainly rock hard fit. FLYING MEAN (5) has a few gear changes on to turn the form around. Back quickly in distance may help too.
